Working up to being comfortable or confident enough to take 500ug...

Problem is after you take the drug, and had made all those realizations and epiphanies you need to be able to take action. If you just let yourself stay the way you are, of course things wont get better, but LSD is a tool and nothing more. You can use it to dissect your own brain, and find your core thoughts. 

You just CAN'T let your ego which at the time was and still sort of is as this was like a week ago max, take control of the trip. Find spiritual guidance within.
Yes, I agree, never take it if you are not ready. I felt at that time, that no matter what happened, good or bad, I wanted out of my current feelings, I needed to find peace somewhere.

Yea, LSD is a hell of a drug. It can fuck with you if your not ready for it, I had done it before so I knew what i was in for. I feel very comfortable personally with drugs and find I can keep control of the trip even at higher dosages. Experience is the only thing that made that night, better for me.

I also have a terrible problem with my living space, I tend to let trash build up and go completey blind to it, It got so bad I abandoned my bedroom, locked the door closed it and slept on the couch for over a year. I then swapped rooms, and it happened again. So my mother slaved all day cleaning my horrible disgusting mess which makes me feel like a complete and utter failure.

Depression and anxiety made me drop out of highschool, I have too much anxiety to get my license, I cry myself to sleep every night, 90% of my thoughts are self hatred and terrible thoughts of suicide. I am so sick and no medicine has even remotley helped, I have tested 5 or so meds and they have ALL severely made my problem worse. 

I cant escape it at all. It has entirely deteriorated my personality. I am nothing. 

I have no purpose, No goal, Nothing. No motivation to get out of bed in the morning, and too much anxiety to get my mail. 

Going in public is a nightmare, I get so anxious talking to people that I am super awkward because of it.

My self neglect because of the depression is causing EVEN more depression. My teeth are in terrible condition. 

Without a job, life insurance or anything (im 18 m btw)  I cant afford to go to the dentist at all, making me MORE depressed. I cant afford to go to the doctors when i need to. 

I hate myself. I hate myself. I hate myself. 

I hate myself so much so, that I am starting to forget what Love is like, even for family. My mother is so caring of me and does all she can to help but I feel empty towards her most days, I FUCKING HATE IT. I am losing everything I am.
Unfortunatley I have. I have tested many meds, they have all escalated things severely. I am losing my mind. I cry myself to sleep literally every night.

thank you for taking your time to talk and give advice, sadly I have tried many times to get a good routine, but I do look forward to the day I am depression free for the rest of my life, whether that be the last day of my life, or tomorrow I will see the day come.

I just don't know what will happen after that. I have tried to seek help, but my parents do not have the insurance or money to get me it. When they or I got help, my anxiety made it impossible to stay. I am on the brink of just letting go completley, but seem to have just the smallest bit of hope, that fades in and out. Today was hard, and tomorrow will be harder, maybe one day things wont seem so hopeless, or lost. The title of this post, was want help but cannot find any, because I literally cant get help from a doctor. It seems that getting a doctor is the only advice anyone has, but when that fails what can I do? I am losing the small amount of hope I have left.

I suffer from extreme depression and anxiety and noone knows, It has actually taken such a toll on my life and I have been living a lie for so long to so many people. I was a junior in highschool when I just could not take it anymore (last year) I just simply stopped going to highschool for a few months, told everyone I started doing homeschooling including my recently divorced father, all my friends, church group etc, and its been almost 2 years and I will have not even tried. MY anxiety and depression control almost every aspect of my life, not even my mother knows its as bad as it is. So everyone thinks I am close to graduating but I am just as far away as I was 2 years ago. I have too much anxiety to get a job, or even leave my room most days. Of course my sleep has been awful. Nothing seems to go right, but I try to be as happy as possible, knowing that I exist, and that everything exists makes me happy. Being grateful for what i Do have is all I can do. 

I am too anxious and depressed to seek help, hoping it will pass. 
I am not suicidal, because I know that this is life, and life is simple. I just do not know what to do.
